mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,kind,title,body FROM t_notify_outbox WHERE status='pending' AND channel='inapp' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT id,channel FROM t_notify_outbox WHERE status='pending' AND channel!='inapp' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 500 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notify_outbox SET status='sent',sent_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),reason=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_channel_configs cc WHERE cc.enabled=1 AND cc.channel_type=#{mapped}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_channel_secrets_probe p WHERE p.channel=#{channel} AND p.ready=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notify_outbox SET status='blocked',reason='CHANNEL_NOT_CONFIGURED:后台通道配置未启用' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending'
